# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-FRUIT v0.1/r0.6

Status: frozen v0.1/r0.6 finite one-way producer-envelope scientific boundary;
no FRUIT contract, algorithm, implementation, or use is authorized

Producer: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`

Future consumer authority: separate `SCI-FRUIT` contract tranche

Each signal bundle records the FH named-use status: `not_requested`,
`inapplicable`, `unavailable`, `compatible`, `requested_pending`, or
`realized_child_exists`. The returned FH role record uses the frozen role-
semantics definition but remains SCI-VAL-unregistered and unevaluable. The
base signal never requires a FRUIT child, and a child never mutates its parent.

The finite `Q_FLT^0.1` envelope identifies the filtered quantity and
per-anchor value/validity/lifecycle; parent and anchor identity/WCS; template
and amplitude convention; local/application support; fixed-state scientific
and available realized/reference response; method/resolved-state/producing-
map/numerical-profile identity; named U1/U2 roles and availability;
units/calibration; provenance; and exact state/response reconstruction
declarations. It carries `optimality_status`; the human title and method ID are
not claim evidence.

`V_FRUIT_handoff` is a subset of `V_signal` or a bundle predicate. A handoff
may exist only after the FLT signal is Realized and complete for publication-
policy evaluation. PublicationDecided follows that complete candidate and
precedes Published or NotProduced. Unsupported queries are unavailable and
require a successor FLT envelope. The boundary defines no FRUIT model,
recurrence, subtraction/add-back, learning, stopping, restart, selection,
response, uncertainty, convergence, interpretation, or SRC behavior. FRUIT
receives its own scientific contract tranche.
